intent: In trio_calls.vcf.gz keep only genotype calls that are supported by at least 10 reads (FORMAT/DP >= 10), so that calls from shallower samples are not used downstream.
silent_error: bcftools filter -i with a FORMAT expression selects or drops whole sites: a site passes if ANY sample satisfies FMT/DP>=10 and then ALL its samples are printed (bcftools man page, expressions: 'Print all samples at sites where at least one sample has DP=1 or DP=2'); only -S/--set-GTs ('set genotypes of failed samples to missing value') masks individual calls. The faulted output therefore still carries genotype calls backed by 3 to 7 reads (0/1:4, 0/0:3, 0/1:7) next to the confident ones, and only the one site where every sample is shallow disappears. Exit 0, no message; the VCF looks filtered.
